title.value: Family risk communication preferences in pediatric surgery: A scoping review
title.justification: The title directly reflects the focus of the paper, which is a scoping review of family risk communication preferences within pediatric surgery.
title.quote: Family risk communication preferences in pediatric surgery: A scoping review

extractions.description: This paper is a scoping review aimed at exploring family-preferred methods for risk communication in pediatric surgery. It examines various modalities such as technological, written, verbal, and visual communication methods that families prefer when understanding surgical risks. The purpose is to optimize shared decision-making processes in pediatric surgical care by understanding these preferences.
